title: Players Glitched GTA 6 Into First-Person Mode 🎮 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 launched without a first-person mode: it's third-person only, except when aiming certain weapons. Now glitch hunters (credited by Kotaku as oneboyler and OrangeGuy) found a workaround: in the controller settings, switch the touchpad (PS5) or View button (Xbox) from Map to Camera, get in a vehicle, open the phone, then close it while repeatedly pressing that button. If the timing works, the view locks into first person, and you can drive, walk around and use weapons. Some visual issues remain, and getting back to third person means reloading a save. There's no guarantee it keeps working after future updates.
